title: Iintsika Eziphakamileyo Zeendunduma Eziphetshethwa Ngumoya
intro: Khawucinge ngempucuko echumayo enikwe amandla amakhulu kunye nobuchule obungenakuthelekiswa nanto bokwakha. Olu luntu luhleli phakathi kweenduli ezinkulu ezigobileyo, lwaphakamisa iimpawu ezinkulu ezafikelela kumphezulu. Kodwa ke ikratshi laqala ukukhula, kwaye ubizo lokubuyela ekunquleni u-Allah kuphela lwahlangatyezwa ngendelelo. Okwalandela oko kusaqhubeka njengesilumkiso esiqhutywa ngumoya ngokwawo.
clues: Sasiluhlanga olunamandla oluza emva kwabantu bakaNuh, sibusisiwe ngobude namandla amakhulu.
Sakha iinqaba eziphakamileyo kunye nezikhumbuzo kuzo zonke iindawo eziphakamileyo ngenxa yemidlalo nokuzingca nje.
Saziqhayisa, sithi ngubani onamandla kunathi ngamandla, saza senza ngobuzwilakhe ngaphandle kwenceba.
Simgatyile isithunywa sethu uHud xa wayesibiza ukuba sinqule uAllah yedwa, simbiza ngokuba ubuthathaka kwaye ungumxoki.
Simhleka usulu isilumkiso saza samcela ukuba asizisele isohlwayo awayesisongela ngaso ukuba wayethetha inyani.
Satshatyalaliswa ngumoya onamandla nongenamanzi ubusuku obusixhenxe neentsuku ezisibhozo, sashiywa siwile njengeziqu zemithi yesundu.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
